title: RWB-S8-E7009-APP: neither deviation nor any other owned table carries a complaint or contact reference, no published rule row expresses the match, no requirement row traces to FEAT-DVF-09, the Conduct and QA officer holds R only while the feature needs U, the plan's C row is empty while two contracts are consumed, DP-04, DP-05, DP-09 and DP-18 are absent, and no event carries the match to rwb-reporting
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S8-E7009-APP; context pack S8 rwb-deviation (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 8 and 13); legacy RWB-E7-009; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A1.1, A1.2, A1.3, A1.4, A2.18 and A2.18.4; TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules and States sheets; Event and Messaging Design v4 events EV-06 and EV-07; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DVF-09
description: (1) The match binds a complaint to a contact, yet deviation has no reference to either: TSD S8 T3.1 lists DF-CAS-036 to DF-CAS-045 only (id, case_id, deviation_code, raised_at, raised_by, paused_state, handler_user_id, contact_stop, cleared_at, outcome), the FSD S8 A2.18.3.2 field catalog lists the same eight fields, and the API Specification v4 Deviation element and DeviationOutcome request declare no complaint or contact property and no match outcome. (2) No rule row expresses the match: the DEV set holds R-DEV-01 to R-DEV-22 and none of them names a complaint, a contact or a conduct match, and the universal set holds no such row either, so legacy AC1's 'rule version' can only be the package version in force and no rule ID is recorded as the match's own. (3) TSD S8 T8 maps every REQ-DVH and REQ-S8 row to FEAT-DVH-01, FEAT-DVF-01 or 'Written one epic ahead', so no requirement row traces to FEAT-DVF-09 and the legacy story carries no REQ id of its own. (4) FSD S8 A2.18.3.3 names 'Conduct and QA officer' as the primary role and the legacy permission table gives the case record right U, while TSD S8 T6.1 gives RW-CONDUCT R only, so the primary role of the feature cannot record the match under the matrix. (5) The plan gives H = RWB-S8-E7009-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the contact of rwb-source-data and the package version of rwb-decision, so two consumed rows have no plan row. (6) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates the DEV route set of 22 rules over 9 states; DP-05 and DP-18 are absent although the contact and the interaction ledger are P1's; DP-09 is absent although the service owns topic rwb.deviation.events.v1. (7) FSD S8 A2.18.2 names EFS as an integration point while the S8 row of the connection matrix names REST and events to P1 and nothing to EFS, so a direct EFS call would be invented. (8) rwb-reporting listens to S8 on the connection matrix while the service publishes EV-06 and EV-07 only, neither of which carries a match, so the conduct measure has no projected event. (9) The legacy screen table gives SCR-08 Deviation queue 'Loading; list' and SCR-06 Raise deviation 'Form; saved' and neither is described as a matching screen, so the place of the match action on a screen has no source. (10) The legacy permission table names eight roles with right U 'and 4 more' without enumerating them.
evidence: TSD S8 T3.1 field list DF-CAS-036 to DF-CAS-045 and T3.2 lists LOV-DEV-OUTCOME, LOV-DEVIATION and LOV-RAISED-BY only; FSD S8 A2.18.3.2 field catalog of the eight deviation fields and A2.18.3.3 roles 'Conduct and QA officer' primary, 'Complaint officer' also uses; API Specification v4 elements Deviation, DeviationRequest and DeviationOutcome; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DEV-01 to R-DEV-22 and rows R-UNI-04 and R-DEV-02; TSD S8 T6.1 giving RW-CONDUCT R and RW-CASEOWN CRU on the case record; TSD S8 T8 mapping every REQ row away from FEAT-DVF-09; context pack connection matrix row S8 (events from P3, REST and events to P1, Temporal and events to P2-free P10) and row P9 (E from S8); Event and Messaging Design v4 events EV-06 and EV-07; FSD S8 A2.18.2 integration points 'Workbench, EFS'; legacy RWB-E7-009 Data, Endpoints, Screen and states and Permission checks
area: Field definition, rule coverage, requirement trace, role mapping, dependency row, screen and event projection
owner_role: Solution architect; business lead; access owner in rwb-access
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; carry the complaint and contact references and the match outcome as request inputs recorded on the local decision record until the business lead confirms their names, formats and value set; declare the two consumed rows in sections 12.2 and 12.8 and record the absent DP-04, DP-05, DP-09 and DP-18 rows; read the contact through rwb-source-data as the connection matrix gives it and never through EFS; authorise the match on the case-record right U the permission table gives and record the matrix row as the conflict; let the trace rest on the legacy key and the feature row until the E7 BRD and the PRD publish a requirement; leave the conduct measure on the decision-record ledger until an event exists

title: RWB-S8-E7009-CON: the Deviation, DeviationRequest and DeviationOutcome elements carry no complaint or contact reference and no match outcome, no source publishes their names, formats or value set, the two consumed operation names have no published baseline, no requirement row traces to FEAT-DVF-09, and the plan's C row is empty while the baseline declares two consumed rows
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S8-E7009-CON; context pack S8 rwb-deviation; legacy RWB-E7-009; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A2.18.2, A2.18.3.1, A2.18.3.2 and A2.18.4.4; TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T8 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; API Specification v4 elements Deviation, DeviationRequest and DeviationOutcome; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-DEV-09; Event and Messaging Design v4 events EV-06 and EV-07
description: (1) TSD S8 T-A.2 publishes the request element names DeviationRequest and DeviationOutcome, the answer element Deviation and the error status codes 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503, but no property of the match, no complaint reference, no contact reference, no match outcome and no message ID per condition. (2) No source publishes the names, the formats or the value set of the two references: the FSD field catalog of A2.18.3.2 lists the deviation fields only and TSD S8 T3.2 publishes LOV-DEV-OUTCOME, LOV-DEVIATION and LOV-RAISED-BY and nothing for a match. (3) No source publishes the operation names of the contact read of rwb-source-data or the package read of rwb-decision, and the S8 row of the connection matrix names REST and events to P1 without naming an operation. (4) TSD S8 T8 maps every REQ-DVH and REQ-S8 row to FEAT-DVH-01, FEAT-DVF-01 or 'Written one epic ahead', so the baseline has no requirement row to trace to and the legacy story carries no REQ id. (5) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the baseline declares two consumed rows, and DP-04, DP-05, DP-09 and DP-18 are absent from the pattern set although the step evaluates a package, reads a contact, owns a topic and takes the ledger from P1 by the default ruling. (6) The match has no path of its own: the legacy endpoints are the two module operations and no source publishes an operation for a complaint-to-contact match.
evidence: TSD S8 T-A.1 operations API-S8-001 and API-S8-002 with request DeviationRequest, answer Deviation and right U, T-A.2 operations with request DeviationOutcome and error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids, T3.1 field list DF-CAS-036 to DF-CAS-045, T3.2 three lists and no other, T5.3 events DeviationRaised and DeviationCleared, T8 mapping every REQ row away from FEAT-DVF-09; API Specification v4 Deviation element of ten properties with seven required, DeviationRequest of three properties and DeviationOutcome of two properties; FSD S8 A2.18.3.1 rules VR-S8-018-1 and BR-S8-018, A2.18.3.2 field catalog and A2.18.4.4 no background event; context pack connection matrix row S8; split plan slice RWB-S8-E7009-CON with empty H, C, I and X
area: Contract surface, interface names, value sets and requirement trace
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the match inside the one published deviation-outcome operation and not as a second path, declare the contact and package rows as consumed and faked, record the decision-record element, the lists of TSD S8 T3.2 and the rights, and trace to the legacy key and the feature row until the E7 BRD and the PRD publish a requirement
